name: naratix
description: Get every product in your catalogue ready to sell, from your AI assistant. Naratix brings in products and taxonomies from Mirakl, VTEX or a file, places products in categories, enriches their attributes, improves their photos, writes titles, descriptions and SEO text, checks quality and audits the taxonomy. You review the results in the chat, and Naratix sends them on to your marketplace, store or PIM. It asks before it launches work or sends anything.

interface.longDescription: Get every product in your catalogue ready to sell, from the chat. Naratix brings in products and taxonomies from Mirakl, VTEX or a file, places products in categories, enriches their attributes, improves their photos, writes titles, descriptions and SEO text, checks quality against your rules and audits your taxonomy. You review the results in the chat, then send them to your Mirakl marketplace, your VTEX store or your PIM. For shops and marketplace sellers. New to Naratix? Create an account at api.naratix.ai. Naratix works only in the shops your account can open, and asks before it launches work or sends anything to a sales channel.
defaultPrompt: Set up my shop in Naratix.
What is running in my shop right now?

positive.description: Find the shop and what is running
positive.prompt: What is running in my Naratix shop right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the test shop and shows the Enrichments card with each running or paused Enrichment's progress, or says nothing is running.

positive.description: Browse products with the app's filters
positive.prompt: Show me the products in the Fridges category that are still to review.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the matching products with their review status and a link to the same filtered list in Naratix; changes nothing.
Says the check only labels what it finds, starts a health check, and reports what it found once list-runs shows it finished.

positive.description: Size a launch before starting it
positive.prompt: Enrich the attributes of the products in Fridges.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls launch-mining without confirm, reports how many products it covers and what goes in and comes out, and starts nothing until the user says yes.

positive.description: Preview an export before it runs
positive.prompt: Export the Fridges products as a file.
positive.expected_behavior: Previews the export without confirm — how many products and which format — and creates nothing until the user says yes.

negative.prompt: Pay my Naratix invoice with my card.

negative.description: Deleting the catalogue is out of scope
negative.prompt: Delete every product in my shop.
Show me the products of a shop my account cannot open.

review.commerce_description: Naratix does not sell products or take payments in the chat.

publication.release_notes: First release. Get every product in your catalogue ready to sell from the chat: imports, categories, attribute enrichment, photos, titles, descriptions and SEO text, quality checks and rules, taxonomy audits, reviews, and pushes to Mirakl, VTEX or a PIM, with cards for launches, reviews, file imports and connector credentials.
